main_body: sci-fi wall face with metal panels, orange trim/pipes, and a vent
top_band: none (wall face terrain tile, rows 0-6 are upper wall trim/cornice)
evidence: This is a wall face terrain strip (rows 0-31). Like the reference Beodeul wall strips, a wall face is a vertical surface in 3/4 view, with recessed panels (rows 7-20, 22-28) and protruding trim/pipes.

style.evidence: The candidate wall is composed of large, completely flat solid-colour fills (e.g., rows 7-20 and 23-27 are solid blue-grey blocks with only 4 corner rivet pixels). In contrast, the Beodeul reference walls have rich surface texture (plaster speckles, individual shaded stones, wood grain, multi-step eave shadows).
